note: Graphics get their own zone. Measurement of the delivered short showed no region of the frame stays clear of Dan (best slot clear 33% of frames, 0% at worst), so the band is created rather than found. Bonus: the block upscales the 1080p source ~1.32x instead of the 1.78x a full-bleed 9:16 crop needs, so it is sharper.
overlayNote: The V4 source carries its own teal pills in the left third of the 16:9 frame across the whole of shot 2. They are the same information our band chips carry, so the crop is kept to the right of x=693 and they are simply excluded — never half-cropped.
cropNote: `x` is the subject centre as a fraction of source width. Set by eye and confirmed on the preview sheet: automated centroid/silhouette detection kept locking onto the background trees or the source overlay, and this footage has only 6 shots.

0.why: full-screen '4 MUSCLE GROUPS OF YOUR ABS' title card — a 9:16 crop slices the text, so the whole frame is fitted into the block

2.why: must start right of the source overlay at x=693

4.why: plank b-roll — a horizontal pose. A 9:16 crop keeps the head and one arm and loses the straight-body line, so it stops reading as a plank; the whole frame goes in the block instead

fitcardNote: Fitcards sit 70px below the block top, not centred. A 1000x563 card centred in the 1425-tall block spans y 861-1424; the ASS caption band (MarginV 690) starts around y=1150, so centring drew captions across the card.
